answer: Trust-weighted PageRank with sink penalty resists sybils: trust rank flows from the honest seed, and nodes that absorb trust without passing legitimate flow onward — the sink pattern of a sybil collecting edges but contributing nothing back to the anchor — are penalized. A cluster at the wharf hoarding inbound vouches to no honest purpose drains toward the zenith of its own dead end and the sink penalty docks it. Honest nodes both receive and redistribute trust; a fake sink is detected by the asymmetry and down-weighted.
